title: Kohler refuses to name his sources

tellings.quote: The information it was told to me as a story. However, the names where I got it from was entrusted to me as a confidency

plain: In 1950, at the KMYR radio station in Denver, a man named George Kohler refused to name the people who gave him a story the episode ties to crashed alien bodies. In his own words, the information 'was told to me as a story,' but 'the names where I got it from was entrusted to me as a confidency.'
